summary: Parlin Field (NWH) is a small general aviation airport serving Newport, New Hampshire, in the Sullivan County region of the upper Connecticut River valley. The airport primarily accommodates private pilots, flight training, and recreational flying, with no scheduled commercial service. Its single turf runway and rural setting make it a popular destination for fly-in visitors exploring the lakes region of central New Hampshire.
faqs:
Q: Does Parlin Field offer commercial airline service?
A: No, Parlin Field is a general aviation airport with no scheduled commercial flights. It primarily serves private pilots, flight training, and recreational aviation.

Q: What facilities are available at the airport?
A: The airport offers basic general aviation amenities including tie-down parking, fuel availability, and a small terminal area. Pilots should contact the airport manager for current services and field conditions.

Q: Can I rent a car at Parlin Field?
A: Car rental services are not available on-site at this small airport. Visitors typically arrange ground transportation in advance through Newport-based rental agencies or local taxi services.

Q: What is the best time of year to fly into Parlin Field?
A: The airport operates year-round, but summer and early fall offer the most favorable conditions for general aviation operations in New Hampshire, with clearer skies and minimal snow.
transport_tips: Newport is about a 10-minute drive from the airport, accessible via local roads. Rental cars can be arranged from agencies in nearby Claremont or Lebanon, both roughly 20-30 minutes away. The closest major highway is NH Route 10, which connects Newport to surrounding communities.
local_tip: After flying in, drive a few minutes to downtown Newport to visit the Richards Free Library, one of the oldest continuously operating public libraries in New Hampshire, and grab a meal at one of the small-town diners along Main Street.
